description_en: Deletes an IP address from Anti-DDoS Origin and disables protection for that IP address
description_zh: 将被防护IP从DDoS原生防护中移除，取消防护
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp delete-ip --ip-list ip_:_1.XX.XX.1_,_ip_:_2.XX.XX.2 --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-npk1z7t90000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIp

parameters.help_en:
A list of IP addresses to remove from the protected objects of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Specify the list as a string that is a JSON array. Each element in the array is a struct that contains the following field:

ip: The IP address to remove. This parameter is a string and is required.

The IP address must be in the protection list of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
parameters.help_zh:
要从原生防护实例的防护对象中移除的IP地址列表。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：

ip：String类型 | 必选 | 要移除的IP地址。
    
    > IP地址必须已经在原生防护实例的防护列表
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的原生防护实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有原生防护实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query all regions that Anti-DDoS Origin supports
parameters.help_zh:
原生防护实例的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域信息
parameters.name: region_id
